scope: Phase4 bounded public value checks and offline implementation evidence; no database or dotenv access.
measurement_status: 17 candidates have dated measured, blocked or inconclusive outcomes; two providers built after passing the specified gates.
count_semantics: Historical counts are dated evidence. Current captured vendor observations prove only linked frontend use, not accessible full inventory. Null is unknown, never zero. Archive hostnames are candidates, not proven employers.
network_constraints: One host at a time; >=1 second between same-host requests, >=2.5 seconds and one connection across icims.com.
First 403, 405, 429 or challenge stops that host. Honor robots and human-readable automated-collection prohibitions.
Use tenant_discovery with a no-retry paced transport wrapper; its default _get retries 429, which this task forbids.
Do not call probe_new_ats candidate-pattern sweeps: paths must come from the public page or documented API.
